QuestInfo.name: Arec's Lost Dagger
QuestInfo.0: #bCategory: Resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King - Escort, Party Quest#k\r Type: Optional Quest\r\nContent: #bArec#k has something to ask of you before you leave to prevent the resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the Hoblins at the Ice Ravine and bring the #b#t4032647:##k that #bArec#k lost back to him.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #b#t4032647:##k that #bArec#k lost back to him.

0.0: Hey you. If you're going to the Ice Ravine, can you look for an item I lost there?

yes.0: It was towards the end of the Battle at Ice Ravine. We had Rex pushed back and were taking a small break. I was on guard while the others slept when a group of Hoblins attacked! I saw one of them heading towards Pedro. Since I was too far way, I threw a dagger at the Hoblin. That dagger had been passed down to me by my teacher.
yes.1: The Hoblin fell down the Ravine and my #bDagger#k was lost. I have no regrets, since I was able to save the life of a friend. Still, I would like to get the Dagger back if I can. If you get a chance, can you look for it? It's possible that one of the Hoblins may have picked it up and is using it.

no.0: You refuse so easily... It's a very precious item to me so I will reward you handsomely. Please come back if you change your mind.

1.0: I heard that you've been doing some great things. Did you happen to find my lost treasure?

yes.0: This is great! You really found it! I have feeling a little bit guilty all this time for losing it. Now I can be free of my guilt. Thank you.

npc.0: Did you really not find the #t4032647:# that I told you about? I'm sure one of the Hoblins at the Ice Ravine has it.
